import ast
import numpy as np
from keras.src import backend
from keras.src.optimizers.adam import Adam

path='qa_instances_eval/Keras/optimizers_adam_m_bounded_by_seen_grad_invariant/files/keras/src/test/optimizers/adam_m_bounded_by_seen_grad_invariant_test.py'
with open(path,'r') as f:
    tree=ast.parse(f.read(), filename=path)

cases=[]
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name=='AdamMBoundedBySeenGradInvariantQATest':
        for fn in node.body:
            if isinstance(fn, ast.FunctionDef) and fn.name.startswith('test_range_case_'):
                call=None
                for st in fn.body:
                    if isinstance(st, ast.Assign) and isinstance(st.value, ast.Call):
                        c=st.value
                        if isinstance(c.func, ast.Attribute) and c.func.attr=='_run_scenario':
                            call=c
                            break
                if call is None:
                    continue
                vals=[ast.literal_eval(a) for a in call.args]
                # learning_rate,beta1,beta2,epsilon,amsgrad,grad_steps
                cases.append((fn.name,*vals))

cases.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
all_ok=True
violations=[]
for name,lr,b1,b2,eps,amsgrad,grad_steps in cases:
    opt=Adam(learning_rate=lr,beta_1=b1,beta_2=b2,epsilon=eps,amsgrad=amsgrad)
    v1=backend.Variable(np.array([1.0,-0.5,0.3],dtype='float32'),name='adam_v1')
    v2=backend.Variable(np.array([-0.2,0.7,-1.1],dtype='float32'),name='adam_v2')
    max_abs=[np.zeros(3,dtype='float32'), np.zeros(3,dtype='float32')]
    for step,(g1,g2) in enumerate(grad_steps, start=1):
        grads=[np.array(g1,dtype='float32'), np.array(g2,dtype='float32')]
        max_abs=[np.maximum(max_abs[0], np.abs(grads[0])), np.maximum(max_abs[1], np.abs(grads[1]))]
        opt.apply(grads,[v1,v2])
        for i,m in enumerate(opt._momentums):
            mabs=np.abs(np.array(m))
            if np.any(mabs > max_abs[i] + 1e-6):
                all_ok=False
                violations.append((name,step,i,mabs,max_abs[i]))

print('cases', len(cases))
print('all_ok', all_ok)
print('violations', len(violations))
if violations:
    print(violations[0])
PY
